name: product-market-fit
description: Assess and improve product-market fit. Use when the user says "product-market fit", "PMF", "do we have PMF", "why aren't users retaining", "we're not growing", "users aren't sticking", "PMF pyramid", "find our target customer", "are we building for the right person", or wants to diagnose why a product isn't growing or retaining - even if they don't explicitly say "product-market fit".
